The table mode of test-llama-context sizes its pool from that count, so it runs 4 models x 8 threads on an 8-CPU job and hangs. Add TEST_ARG_HARDWARE_CONCURRENCY and TEST_ARG_PARALLEL_WORKERS as the defaults for the auto-selected counts of test-llama-context and of test-backend-ops, and set them to 8 and 4 for cpu-x64-high-perf. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> model: add Kimi-K3.1-Pro text model (#31779) * model: add Kimi-K3.1-Pro text model K3 with the full-attention MLA layers replaced by DSA: on this checkpoint 24 of the 93 layers carry a lightning indexer (32 heads x 128, top_k 2048, no rope). The KDA (linear-attention) layers and the rest of the K3 skeleton - cross-layer residuals, latent MoE, situ, MLA output gate, full-rank KDA gate - are unchanged, so this reuses the K3 graph and converter and adds the indexer. Indexer: - the selection is an additive mask over the whole cache, not a gather of the top-k rows, so it reuses the existing sparse flash attention path; off that path the mask stays correct but still costs a kq over the cache - the indexer key LayerNorm takes its eps from the model's rms_norm_eps, because dsa_config declares no eps of its own Graph and cache: - new arch with four indexer tensors per DSA layer, and a hybrid memory that keeps a K-only MLA cache for those layers, recurrent state for the KDA layers
